title: Protect, turn and escape
outcome: Players grow confident protecting the ball, recognizing open routes and changing direction away from pressure.

fourCorners.technical: players shield the ball and turn away from pressure
fourCorners.physical: players change direction quickly to stay in space or stay safe
fourCorners.psychological: players stay composed with an opponent closing in, rather than rushing a decision

coach_cues: Can you keep the ball on the safe side?

activities.variation: Short paired rounds; explore body position and turns without naming one correct technique.
Choose either exit and counter immediately after a ball win.

progression.note: First half. Coach-managed restarts; rotate the goalkeeper.
Second half, same setup. Switch ends; rotate anyone who hasn't played every role.
